title: Vectors: create hash_32.json with byte-order and width test cases
description:
Create test/vectors/hash_32.json with:
- EUI-64 inputs in big-endian
- DODAG ID (16-byte) inputs
- Integer fields (SFN, epoch) in big-endian
- Edge cases: all-zeros, all-ones, mixed
- Cross-validate Python/Rust/C implementations
